name: Compass Gas e Energia S.A.
summary: Compass Gas e Energia S.A. engages in the distribution and promotion of natural gas in Brazil. The company operates in two segments, Gas Distribution and Marketing and Services. It engages in the distribution of piped natural gas, origination, commercialization and gas supply infrastructure, as well as development of solutions aligned with the energy transition, including biomethane projects. The company serves customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, automotive, cogeneration, and thermoelectric generation. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil. Compass Gas e Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Cosan Dez Participacoes S. A.
